rows.question: Exterior ground beams are 'follow arch.': confirm the depth from outer ground to the GF slab level (main house +1.00, annex +0.30).
Founding level (bottom of footings) - needed for column necks and starter bars.
Stair waist thickness and riser height (or the number of risers per flight).
Swimming pool depths (shallow / deep) - the detail says 'as per arch.'.
Is the p.7 dome built? Where, and how many?
F / F10 footing conflict (OQ3-S1, still open).
Bar bending: adopt a standard for hooks / bends / stirrup closing, or supply the bending schedule.
Confirm the 1.8 x 1.8 m repeated space on all storeys is the lift shaft.
GF entrance / open zone: is the hall-dining-reception zone one open space (no screen)?
Door and window head heights (and sills), or a door / window schedule.
Extras: measure corner beads / spatter dash on all plastered walls? Cornice in which rooms?
Ceiling material per room (gypsum board / plaster / decor) - no reflected ceiling plan.
